reason: The plugin is primarily for request flow automation by adding pre-flight rate control to DeepSeek Harness model provider calls. README clearly states it enforces a per-provider token bucket before request dispatch and queues over-limit requests with delays, which aligns with an automation utility for API traffic control rather than content creation, debugging, UI, or storage functions.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 请求前置限流插件，用于按提供商执行令牌桶节流，并在超额时排队等待以减少 429 返回。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces provider-level token-bucket rate limiting before requests are sent and queues over-limit requests with delay.

capabilities: Prevents request bursts by enforcing per-provider token-bucket throttling before requests are sent
Queues excess requests with delays instead of failing immediately
Supports abort-aware waiting so queued delays can be canceled when the user stops the request

reasons.code: The plugin is described as a proactive rate limiter that controls request rate per provider before model requests are issued.
It is explicitly configured at install/use time with provider-specific `rate` and `burst` values in the profile patch.
When over limits are reached, requests are queued with delay rather than rejected, which can delay or defer operations but does not drop requests.
Repository description identifies it as a proactive rate limiter plugin for DeepSeek Harness, confirming the plugin-level purpose.
